gameFlow: index.html:19-36 registers scenes [TitleScene, MenuScene, ArenaScene, HudScene, ResultScene]. TitleScene -> MenuScene (src/ui/MenuScene.js:325 starts ArenaScene) -> ArenaScene + HudScene overlay -> ResultScene (pause/win/lose). ?sandbox query = empty arena, no waves/timer (ArenaScene.js:76-77).

features.summary: Movement and jump: run, variable-height jump (cut on release), coyote time, jump buffer, gravity. Horizontal speed is 0 while attacking or blocking.
Light combo: light1 -> light2 -> light3 (kick finisher). Chain cancel at cancelFrom with an 8-frame input buffer. light1/light2 can cancel into heavy1. Frames at 60fps.
Heavy attack heavy1: single move, cannot chain, not cancelable; heavy pressed during heavy1 is dropped from the buffer.
Dodge (L/C): in-place sway with i-frames then recovery; cooldown. DODGE.speed is 0 so no travel. guardType 'dodge' negates hits.

Parry (Q): dedicated state with reaction clip; first 14 frames negate hits (guardType 'parry'). Negation emits damage-applied with amount 0; no counter-attack, no HP refund (comment in Zed.js:85 says refund needs combat support).
Block (I/V held): instant; first 8 frames of a fresh block count as parry, then plain block. Block keeps stance (no hitstun), keeps 25% knockback in Zed.js and combat takes 25% damage (min 1).
Hitstun state: interrupts attack, lasts N frames, then idle. Zed tints red during stun and gets knockback velocity (decays x0.9/frame). Player takes 400ms invulnerability after a hit (resolver).

Input mapping, keyboard and gamepad. Actions: left, right, jump, light, heavy, block, dodge, parry. Pad: A jump, X light, Y heavy, B/RB dodge, LB/LT/RT block, d-pad/stick move. Gamepad has no parry mapping.
Zed Phaser wrapper: physics sprite, fixed 60Hz state-machine stepping, registers with combat, emits hit-request every active frame with attackId per swing, handles damage/death/retry/respawn.
Zed visual: data-driven pose per state, frame animations (run 8f, attack punch 6f, light3 high kick 7f, dodge 9f, parry 9f), static jump pose, east/west textures; idle/jump use rotation PNGs.

Hit resolver: listens to hit-request, rect overlap vs registered hurtboxes of the opposing team, one hit per attackId per target, damage via health component, guard-aware (dodge/parry negate with amount 0, block reduces). Locks on round end, resets on retry.
Hit-stop: pure helpers capping and merging durations (no stacking, longest wins, cap 150ms). ArenaScene freezes only attacker and target; guarded player hits skip hit-stop.
features.note: ArenaScene only ever uses types light, heavy, playerHurt. 'finisher' and 'ko' types are defined but never requested.

features.summary: Shared combat data: team ids, defaults, and PLAYER_MOVE_COMBAT / GRUNT_ATTACK_COMBAT tables. Comment says moves.js and gruntData.js read from here, but neither imports it; values are duplicated and currently equal.
RustGrunt AI state machine: idle -> approach -> telegraph -> attack -> recover -> approach; hitstun; dead. Circles when attacker slots full; lines up in lane before attacking. Single enemy type only.

EnemyManager: spawns grunts from wave specs, registers them with combat, applies hit reactions from damage-applied, 600ms corpse linger then unregister, frozen-id set for hit-stop. AttackSlots caps simultaneous attackers.
WaveSpawner: 3 waves of grunts with start delay, spawn interval, maxAlive; clears emit wave-cleared then next wave-started, final emits arena-cleared. Restarts on retry.

Arena bounds and camera lock: while a wave is active camera is held at the wave lockX and fighters clamped to the screen with margin; unlocked between waves/after clear, camera follows player. Lane clamp on Y. Eases scroll with lerp 0.12. World wider than view (1920 vs 1280), so scroll range is limited.
Arena failsafe: clamps enemies each frame; enemies off-screen or stuck are teleported to a spawn point, removed after 3 teleports (counts toward wave clear).
Round state: 120s countdown, timer-tick per second, round-lost 'timeout' at 0, round-lost 'ko' on player death, round-won 'cleared' on arena-cleared; unlimited retries resetting the timer.

ArenaScene integration: wires resolver, round state, Zed, Arena, hit-stop, screen shake (100ms/0.0023 on player hit; 120ms/0.003 on finisher-level damage), spark FX, enemy sprites (single placeholder SVG), telegraph icon and hitbox overlay, pause (Esc/P/gamepad Start/tab blur), end-of-round delay 700ms. Enemies target Zed ground-line x, so jumping avoids them.

HUD: ZED health bar (360px, mustard, red under 30%), HP text, wave counter, enemies-left, mm:ss timer (red at <=10s), wave banner (FIGHT! then WAVE n), Esc pause hint. Pure event consumer. Does not read the timerVisibility option.
ResultScene: pause (Resume / Restart / Main Menu with confirm) and win/lose result with stats (waves cleared, defeated, time, hp); Restart emits retry.

TitleScene and MenuScene (wheatpaste wall main menu, FIGHT starts ArenaScene, emits start-game). Options panel with 12 settings across audio/video/gameplay/accessibility, persisted to localStorage key rebellion.options.v1 and set on registry 'options'. Comment at MenuScene.js:255 says nothing consumes the settings yet.
features.note: optionsData tested; scenes untested. No code reads registry 'options' outside MenuScene (grep).

features.summary: Asset key tables: ASSET_KEYS/ASSET_PATHS for bg, buttons, menu assets, palette, fonts. Arena background, grunt, telegraph, spark are placeholder SVGs; Zed uses PNG frame sets under assets/sprites/zed/. asset-keys.json lists zed animations (idle, walk, jump, light, heavy, hit, ko) and grunt animations that no code registers: grunt is a single static image with tint. There is no audio code (no sound load/play anywhere in src).
